referenceName: Spicer local auto-repair symptom triage and inspection

source.name: Spicer Designs Auto Repair HTML template
source.rightsEvidence: The official source page states CC BY 4.0 and commercial use with the footer credit retained. The downloaded package includes its LICENSE and README, which identify the bundled hero artwork as AI-generated placeholder art and require keeping the Spicer Designs footer link.

provenance.attribution: The unmodified source HTML retains the required linked Spicer Designs footer credit, visible in both captures. This is an independent local repair-shop template, not manufacturer or automaker marketing.
provenance.capture: Rendered locally from the exact official HTML archive at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844. Captures use the package's built-in prefers-reduced-motion static fallback so all scroll-reveal content is visible. Source files were not edited.
provenance.qa: Body and document widths matched the viewport at desktop and mobile. The sole bundled hero image loaded. The static HTML has no reveal observer: 21 ar-rise groups remain hidden in the default motion preference, while reduced motion exposes them. FAQ uses native details; click-driven matcher widgets are presentational and the contact form opens a local email draft rather than submitting to a server.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A local repair-shop experience that begins with diagnostic confidence and evidence, not an automaker's product catalog. A narrow call/hour utility bar precedes a dark service-bay hero with a clear diagnostic CTA and a compact facts strip. The next section asks what the vehicle is doing and pairs a symptom list with a proposed service explanation. A focused service grid follows, then a transparent labor-rate/make-served area and a digital inspection explanation that prioritizes findings for the vehicle owner. Repair commitments, genuine reviews, FAQ, and a short diagnostic request form close the page. The design is square-cornered, dark, and information-dense, with a single signal-red action color.

heroGeometry.alignment: dark wide workshop image with left-aligned diagnostic headline and actions; compact verified service facts run beneath the text
heroGeometry.viewport: business name, diagnosis-first promise, main booking action, secondary symptom prompt, and only verified service facts are visible in the opening

navigationGeometry.mode: small repair-shop wordmark, direct service anchors, and phone/hours utility
navigationGeometry.placement: thin status/contact bar above a restrained hero navigation
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact wordmark and call/menu utilities above a vertically stacked diagnostic promise and action

typography.display: intended Inter heavy sans, though the static HTML font utility is miscompiled and resolves to system sans
typography.body: intended Inter neutral sans with mono-like data labels, though font-family mapping must be verified
typography.scale: large concise diagnostic headline, compact technical labels, readable service rows, and explicit numeric metadata

palette.contrastIntent: technical dark field with red used sparingly for booking and urgent signals; all body text remains legible

imageTreatment.mode: AI-generated auto-service bay image under a dark overlay
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero crop that retains vehicle/bay context and text-safe negative space; later sections use typography and diagrams rather than more photography
imageTreatment.focalPoint: local repair environment, not an automaker, brand vehicle campaign, identifiable technician, or customer

servicePresentation.pattern: visitor-led symptom triage followed by a concise service grid and transparent labour-rate context; digital inspection explains how findings are documented and prioritized
servicePresentation.interaction: symptom options are presentational in the static HTML archive; only create a matcher if each result is mapped to verified services and includes an unsure/contact path

ctaPlacement.primary: diagnostic request in the hero and the final form
ctaPlacement.secondary: symptom matcher prompt and direct call action
ctaPlacement.early: before the service list, with diagnostic process detail immediately after the symptom prompt

motion.primitive: selection state in a symptom matcher and sequential digital-inspection steps
motion.library: CSS transitions in the static package; no reveal observer is included in the HTML build
motion.reducedMotion: show the complete symptom list, static inspection steps, and all service information without transforms

rules: keep phone and hours utility readable
stack symptom options above their explanation and CTA
convert service grid to compact labeled rows
keep labour rate and vehicle coverage text readable without sideways scroll
present digital inspection steps in a vertical numbered sequence and stack the form

prohibitedPatterns: copying Spicer name, sample shop identity, source copy, hero image, ratings, prices, warranty pledge, or footer attribution out of a derivative
reusing sample diagnostic fees, labour rates, makes serviced, insurance/law statements, service results, or testimonials as client facts
inventing certifications, warranty coverage, safety guarantees, supported makes, diagnostic outcome, turnaround time, or shop hours
presenting the AI-generated shop image as the client's actual bay or staff
automaker/vehicle-manufacturer product marketing rather than a local repair business
leaving source matcher controls looking live when they are presentational
hidden reveal content or an untruthful booking form

requiredSignatureElements.description: a local service-bay image and diagnosis-first promise rather than vehicle model launch marketing
a small set of common verified symptom routes with a safe unsure/diagnostic option
a concise explanation of the client's actual inspection evidence and approval process
verified labor-rate or diagnostic-fee basis placed where visitors evaluate a repair request

acceptanceChecks: the opening clearly reads as an independent local repair shop, not automaker advertising
symptom choices map only to verified services and never diagnose a visitor's vehicle
labor rates, diagnostic fees, service makes, warranties, hours, and claims come from sealed business facts
mobile symptom and service sections have no horizontal overflow
form route and any matcher behavior are tested and described truthfully
reduced-motion/default behavior never hides section content
CC BY footer attribution remains linked in any adapted template

review.scope: Official package/license, single AI-generated hero asset, Google Fonts OFL metadata, local full-page renders, attribution, and responsive inspection.
